brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: hex-acc-keyhole on slot 0 at levels 0 and 2 (accessory:0#0,0#0, accessory:2#0,0#0). The column's slot-0 faces are flat in one plane, so that side goes against the wall. The configurator checks fit only, not how much weight the hangers can carry.

9 hex-acc-hook plates (18 hooks) on slots 2, 3 and 4 at all three levels, facing away from the wall. Shown with gaffer tape and a cable coil hung on them: those are the only hang props the configurator offers. It has no hanging version of hand tools like screwdrivers or pliers, so none are shown on the hooks.

3 stacked full pieces joined by snaps; lockJoints ran and capOpenFaces added one cap. 6 wall-angled faces (slots 1 and 5) are still open; check_build lists them as info only. check_build passes and the mesh-collision check reads clear.

finish.summary: I built a wall tool rack from three full hex cells stacked into one column, three storeys tall. All the cells' back faces (slot 0) sit in one flat plane, which is the side that goes against the wall. Two keyhole hangers are fitted on that face, one at the bottom storey and one at the top. Nine hook plates, two hooks each (18 hooks in total), sit on the front face and the two front-angled side faces (slots 2, 3, 4) of every storey. I ran capOpenFaces and lockJoints. capOpenFaces added just one cap. The check lists 6 faces that could still take a cap, on the two wall-angled sides (slots 1 and 5) of each storey; it rates them info only. check_build passes and the mesh-collision check reads clear. The configurator checks fit only, not how much weight the rack or the hangers can hold. For staging I hung gaffer tape and a cable coil on the hooks. Those are the only items the configurator lets me hang on a hook; none of its screwdriver, plier or file props can hang. One gaffer tape was refused on a bottom hook because it would have reached the bench.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
